llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注术后预防措施，不涉及髋关节植入物生物力学或有限元分析。

summary_zh.motivation: 探究微创后路全髋置换术后6周预防措施是否必要
summary_zh.method: 纳入微创后路全髋置换患者，分为预防措施组与对照组比较
summary_zh.result: 术后6周预防措施可能不必要，但结论需进一步验证
summary_zh.validation: 临床对照研究，基于患者术后随访结果

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates whether a 6-week hip precaution protocol is necessary after minimally invasive posterior total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Patients undergoing minimally invasive posterior total hip arthroplasty were divided into groups with and without preoperative education on hip precautions.
summary_en.result: The study found no significant difference in dislocation rates between groups, suggesting that extended precautions may not be required.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through prospective comparison of patient outcomes at follow-up.
